<thought>Using the ESI mass spectrum, the most intense peak is at m/z 183.0451. This matches a [M+K]⁺ adduct (K⁺ = 38.9637 Da). Subtracting the potassium mass gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈144.0786 Da. The formula C₇H₁₂O₃ has an exact monoisotopic mass of 144.078645 Da, which fits this value within the experimental tolerance. Therefore, the molecular formula of the compound is C₇H₁₂O₃.</thought>
<final_answer>C7H12O3</final_answer>
